title: Rivian plans to bring outside AI agents into its cars
teaser: Rivian is preparing to let outside AI agents work inside its vehicles, extending a voice assistant that already routes requests between on-device and cloud models. CEO RJ Scaringe did not say when the feature will arrive, and Rivian offered no implementation details, pointing instead to its December “AI and Autonomy Day.” The move matters because Rivian controls its own vehicle software rather than relying on Apple CarPlay or Android Auto—but any third-party agent will have to operate around systems where mistakes can affect safety.
